title: Hall of Arms (Tyr's Hand)

[[File:Hall of Arms (Tyr's Hand).jpg|thumb|The Tyr's Hand Abbey Hall of Arms.]]

The '''Hall of Arms''' wing of [[Tyr's Hand Abbey]], located in [[Tyr's Hand]] in the [[Eastern Plaguelands]], was home to numerous militant members of the [[Scarlet Crusade]]. It is situated south of the [[Main Hall (Tyr's Hand)|Main Hall]], and the [[Library Wing (Tyr's Hand)|Library Wing]] lies on the opposite side of the abbey. The ''Hall of Arms'' points towards the east and only slightly north.
